key.name: app-id
key.description: The .desktop file ID used to launch and track the mdnote window

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut to show/hide the mdnote window

key.name: vertical-margin-px
key.description: Empty space left above and below the mdnote window (which is vertically centered), in pixels

key.name: horizontal-size
key.description: Width of the mdnote window as a percentage of the monitor's work area

key.name: monitor-screen
key.description: Index of the monitor to show mdnote on, or -1 to stay on whichever monitor the window is already on / the mouse is on (recommended for multi-monitor setups)

key.name: render-on-primary-monitor
key.description: When enabled, mdnote always shows on the monitor set as Primary in Displays settings, even if that's not where you're currently working

key.name: auto-hide-window
key.description: When enabled, hides mdnote as soon as another window is focused

key.name: always-on-top
key.description: When enabled, mdnote stays above other windows while shown

key.name: skip-taskbar
key.description: When enabled, mdnote's window is omitted from the Activities overview and window switcher

key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration of the slide-in/slide-out animation in milliseconds
